FN-MDF21WW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 82
Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/05/2025
Senate Bill 82 as introduced would increase the obligations of municipal magistrates and clerks
of circuit court, by an undetermined amount, to: (1) conduct annual audits of warrants issued for
certain Class B and Class C misdemeanors; (2) recall warrants that have not been served within
ten years of the date of issuance; and (3) notify the appropriate law enforcement agencies of
recalled warrants.

FN-MDF21WW-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 82
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/21/2025
Senate Bill 82 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of municipal magistrates and
clerks of circuit court, by an undetermined amount, to: (1) conduct annual audits of warrants
issued for certain Class B and Class C misdemeanors; (2) recall warrants that have not been
served within ten years of the date of issuance; and (3) notify the appropriate law enforcement
agencies of recalled warrants.

FN-MDF21WW-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 82
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/09/2025
Senate Bill 82 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary would increase the obligations of
municipal magistrates and clerks of circuit court, by an undetermined amount, to: (1) conduct
audits of warrants issued for certain Class B and Class C misdemeanors every five years; and (2)
notify the appropriate law enforcement agencies of recalled warrants.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the respective presiding judges to
recall warrants that have not been served within ten years of the date of issuance.
